name: Aoi Hinata
source:
Older brother of the twin brothers. He's mischievous and acts fast. He has a bright and mischievous personality, tends to run ahead, and thinks fondly of his younger brother Yuta. With a warm and lively singing voice, his performance is irregular and free.

He is the leader of 2wink under Cosmic Production.
